thread:
incident-bot: Pager triggered: CUDA OOM on gpu-pool-us-east-2 (multiple hosts). Alert group: kvcache-alloc-fails. PD incident: PAGER-8732.

pagerduty: Page sent to rotation 'eng-oncall' -> assigned Samir Patel.

Samir Patel: acked. pulling logs. which pools are noisy?

sre-automations: summary: 5 hosts flapping (gpu-node-12, gpu-node-13, gpu-node-17, gpu-node-21, gpu-node-22). OOM seen during long-running kv-cache rebuilds, mem usage ~ 31.6GB / 40GB before failure.

Samir Patel: noted. quickly checking skaffold/k8s pods on those nodes. running: `kubectl get pods -o wide -n inference | grep gpu-node-`

Samir Patel: logs: `nvml: out of memory` then `cudaErrorMemoryAllocation` in runtime. repeated 3x across nodes.

Lena Ortiz: Samir can you confirm if Dedicated customers impacted? I saw some error spikes in cost/latency dashboard.

Samir Patel: checking. initial query to trace: `SELECT customer_id, count(*) FROM inference.errors WHERE error LIKE '%cudaErrorMemoryAllocation%' AND ts > now() - 15m GROUP BY customer_id`

Samir Patel: results: 3 customers with elevated failures: cust_acme (5 failures), cust_horizon (3), cust-small (1). Most failures are keyed to long-context rerank jobs.

Marta Chen: thanks. I'm going to open a support note to those customers now. @Support Bot please create incident notes with known ETA.

Support Bot: support ticket created: SUP-4591. Notifying account teams for cust_acme and cust_horizon.

Samir Patel: mitigation plan suggestion: 1) drain affected nodes from new scheduling, 2) trigger KV cache eviction/trim on active workloads, 3) temporarily reduce batch size for rerank routes, 4) fallback low-priority requests to CPU pool.

Lena Ortiz: for 1) can we cordon and drain with graceful termination? Run `kubectl cordon <node>` then `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` but we need to coordinate to avoid mass failover.

Samir Patel: running cordon for gpu-node-21 and gpu-node-22 first.

Samir Patel: cordon complete. starting drain on gpu-node-21 (grace period 30s).

incident-bot: Deploy bot: canary config change applied: `scheduler.max_batch_size=64 -> 48` for route rerank-v2 in us-east-2.

Lena Ortiz: good. reduce batch size is live. watch latencies.

sre-automations: triggered KV-cache trim job on the 5 nodes: `kvcache-trim --pool=us-east-2 --threshold=0.75` -> jobs dispatched.

Samir Patel: observed one node (gpu-node-17) recovered after trim, mem stable ~ 28GB. Others still show pressure.

Marta Chen: customer impact note: cust_acme reporting ~20% elevated error rate; internal SLO for them is 99.9% request success. We should set customer impact = partial degradation.

Samir Patel: escalating to Lena for possible escalation to SRE escalation policy (PD escalate). I recommend PD escalate to oncall lead if not resolved in 15m.

pagerduty: PD escalation scheduled at 1765012446 (15 minutes).

Lena Ortiz: I'm joining. Samir, if drain finishes, we should force-evict heavy KV-rebuild workloads: `pkill -f kv-rebuild` on nodes where appropriate, then restart serving agent process. Will coordinate with infra.

Samir Patel: performed controlled restart on gpu-node-13 agent. After restart, process re-allocated memory but stabilized. error count dropped from 4->0 in last 5m for that node.

sre-automations: note: autoscaler attempted to reschedule pods and increased replica count on CPU pool for low-priority queues to absorb traffic.

Marta Chen: messaging to product and support: drafted update for customers. Preview: "We're mitigating a GPU memory pressure issue affecting rerank jobs in us-east-2. We've applied throttles and are draining impacted nodes. Some customers may see elevated errors for ~30-60m." Approve? :eyes:

Lena Ortiz: approve. Send now.

Support Bot: sent updates to cust_acme and cust_horizon, internal CRM updated.

Samir Patel: drain/gc/trim reduced OOMs. current error rate for cust_acme down to 1/15m from 5/15m.

Lena Ortiz: good. decision: keep P1 status until all nodes stable for 30m and customer errors below threshold. Continue monitoring. Handoff in 40m to Marta for overnight.

Marta Chen: ack. I'll take ownership at 1765012700 handoff. Will keep PD escalation on hold unless spikes.

Samir Patel: posting runbook steps used: ```
- cordon & drain nodes (one at a time)
- run kvcache-trim --pool=<region>
- reduce scheduler.batch_size for affected route
- restart serving agent on recovered nodes
- evict/pkill long-running kv-rebuild tasks if they don't yield
- scale CPU pool for low-priority traffic
```

incident-bot: Incident note appended to PD incident PAGER-8732: mitigations applied, customers notified, nodes cordoned & drained, handoff scheduled.

pagerduty: Pager acknowledged by Samir Patel at 1765012348. Next escalation time: 1765012446.

Marta Chen: leaving a final checklist before I take over: ensure kvcache-trim completed on node-12/22, confirm no new cuda errors in last 10m, keep support updated every 30m.

Samir Patel: all done on trim, errors quieted on 4/5 nodes. one remaining (gpu-node-22) still has intermittent mem spike; I'm going to mark it out of rotation until tomorrow morning.

Lena Ortiz: ok, bumping incident severity to P1 -> extended monitoring. good handoff. thanks team. :clap:

Support Bot: will update tickets every 30m until resolved.

Samir Patel: closing comments: likely root cause correlation with recent kvcache config change rolled yesterday that increases prefetch window for rerank jobs. follow-up: rollback prefetch window and run controlled load test. Adding to follow-up board.

Marta Chen: ack, will own postmortem and rollback PR tomorrow.

incident-bot: Thread closed for now. Add notes to the incident channel if further deviations observed."
